creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-2, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, mannequin template, 8 views, 40-colour palette) then animate_character v3 per direction. East and west are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Elderly xianxia kiln keeper, small human in a plain grey-blue robe, one leather apron strapped over the character's RIGHT shoulder only (asymmetric), holding a very long iron tongs in the RIGHT hand extending down and forward, bald head with a small grey topknot, soot-smudged, calm face. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: stands still and breathes gently, chest and shoulders rising slightly and falling, the long iron tongs stay held low in the same right hand and stay clearly visible

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, breathes gently; the long tongs stay held low in his right hand on the viewer's left, always visible
direction_prompts.west: facing left, breathes gently; the long tongs stay held low in front of him pointing left, always visible
direction_prompts.north: back to the viewer, breathes gently; the long tongs stay held low in his right hand on the viewer's right side, always visible
direction_prompts.east: facing right, breathes gently; the long tongs stay held low in front of him pointing right, always visible

interact.action_description: holds out the long iron tongs a little forward and up, as if presenting a hot ingot, then brings them back down; the tongs always stay in the same right hand and stay clearly visible; the other hand stays at his side

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, lifts the long tongs in his right hand (the viewer's left side of the screen) slightly forward and up, then lowers; tongs never cross to the viewer's right
direction_prompts.west: facing left, holds the long tongs out in front toward the left a little higher, then lowers them; tongs stay on the left
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, his right arm is on the viewer's RIGHT; the long dark iron tongs are held in that right hand beside his body, clearly visible to the right of his back in EVERY frame, raised slightly upward and outward to the viewer's right, then lowered; nothing is held on the viewer's left (second attempt, north only)
direction_prompts.east: facing right, holds the long tongs out in front toward the right a little higher, then lowers them; tongs stay on the right and do not rise above his head

attempts.what: idle = template breathing-idle (4 dir), interact = v3 (4 dir), same character
attempts.result: rejected: idle west and north lost the tongs, interact north on the wrong side, interact south frame 3 flipped, interact east tongs above head. Raw discarded (not shipped).

interact north only, re-generated and appended to the same group (regeneration 2 of interact)
